insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Total sales grew to $2,776 (+22.9% WoW) on 51 units, with organic revenue up to $1,272 (+60.5% WoW). The Platinum White Strap Cuff Batting Gloves led at $232 (+55.0%) on 4 units (+100.0%), with conversion rising to 6.1% (+42.4%). The Pink, On-Deck Orange and Rally Wave Strap Cuff gloves all added sales, and Thursday, Nov 19 was the peak day at $784.

**Metrics to Watch —** Ad spend was stepped up to $882 (prior $478) to push visibility, while PPC revenue held at $1,504 (+2.5%), so the extra investment has not yet turned into proportional ad sales. The upside is clear in organic, which grew +60.5% to $1,272 as the added visibility lifted overall demand. Wednesday, Nov 18 was the softest day at $84. We are refining keyword targeting this week to bring ad returns back in line.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** ROAS came in at 1.71x (prior 3.06x) and TACoS at 31.8% (prior 21.19%), with ACOS at 58.6%, a 0.57% ad CTR and a 3.00% ad conversion rate. Spend was raised to build reach for the batting glove range, and the organic lift shows it is working; we are now trimming non-converting terms and resetting bids to move ROAS back toward 3.06x.

**Actions This Week —** Lower bids on search terms that drew clicks without orders to bring ACOS down from 58.6%. Reallocate that budget to the Platinum White Strap Cuff (6.1% conversion) and Pink Strap Cuff (7.7% conversion) gloves. Test new ad creative to lift the 0.57% ad CTR.
